newsitem.title: HONG KONG: East Asiatic privatisation plan revived.
newsitem.headline: East Asiatic privatisation plan revived.

text.p: The parent of East Asiatic Company (Hong Kong) Ltd is again seeking to privatise the company, an East Asiatic announcement published on Friday said.

"The company has been informed by its parent company it is considering a possible privatisation of the company by the way of a scheme of arrangement involving the cancellation of all shares in the company not held by The East Asiatic Company (Hong Kong) Holdings Ltd," the announcement said.
Shareholders should note no formal proposal had been made or any decision taken in this regard and that such a proposed transaction may or may not happen, it said.
The announcement gave no further details. The parent company made an unsuccessful attempt to privatise the company in 1995.
The share closed at HK$0.97 on Thursday.
